# seekrit_environment_group (Resource)

Composes a group into an application environment. The environment must be application-owned. Precedence is set by `position` (higher wins).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Compose the group into the application environment. `position` is precedence:
# on a name collision, the higher position wins, and the environment's own
# secrets beat every group.
resource "seekrit_environment_group" "web_uses_observability" {
  environment_id = seekrit_environment.production.id
  group_id       = seekrit_group.observability.id
  position       = 0
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) The application environment id (`env_…`) this link belongs to.
- `group_id` (String) The composed group id (`grp_…`).

### Optional

- `position` (Number) Precedence among the environment's composed groups (higher wins). Defaults to appended-last when omitted.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Composition links import as `<environment_id>:<group_id>`.
terraform import seekrit_environment_group.web_uses_observability env_9QpZ3vLmKd8:grp_7Hn2mQxLTb4
```
